about: lev_bonus_m1: the level start: the briefing (or the 600-frame fallback) dismissed, Roman's spawn, camera, the first enemies and triggers for 10 s (traced from 60 frames before play frame 0, so events before a later briefing in one game are seen), a 2 s walk forward from 2 s

known.events.sounds: B17 rest (the sound causes fixed by agent-sound): what is left comes from other families or chance: load-time sounds outside one game's traced window (B10 / E1 start message timing: the base levels' loops, the first ambient one-shot at load vs frame 2), random picks (ambient one-shots, thunder, sheep bleats), the grunts' gait (walk vs run footstep notes, charanim.rs), the grunts' _ic anim-event lines and boulder rolls (not in the remaster yet), vehicle loops (B14, vehicles not traced)
known.grunt.mind: B14 rest: the assault now starts (ai_target_tag: every grunt has Roman as target from the load frame; trigger_charge jumpers take off to markers on the load frame), but the stig gunners' first bursts come ~110 frames after the original's (the original fires 8 frames after the unpause, the remaster after stig_fire_delay + the clip pause) and Roman, hit sooner, dies ~190 frames earlier (the fail screen inside the window)
